risk_summary: The disclosure describes substantial clinical, regulatory, commercialization, and liquidity risks, including termination of the peramivir Phase 3 trial for futility and expected funding sufficiency only into the second quarter of 2014. Although it provides some specific figures and milestones, extensive boilerplate disclaimers and conditional language make future performance and financing prospects difficult to assess.
